# Oxford Learner's Dictionaries

> > Comprehensive English language learning dictionary providing definitions, pronunciations, usage notes, and examples for learners worldwide.

Oxford Learner's Dictionaries is published by Oxford University Press and features the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary (OALD), Oxford Advanced American Dictionary, Oxford Collocations Dictionary, and Oxford Learner's Dictionary of Academic English. The platform includes specialized vocabulary from multiple domains including formal, scientific, legal, and artistic terminology, with integrated pronunciation guides and the OPAL (Oxford Phrasal Academic Lexicon) framework for academic English.

## Key Topics

- Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary
- English vocabulary
- Pronunciation guide
- Word definitions
- OPAL (Oxford Phrasal Academic Lexicon)
- Practical English Usage
- Oxford Collocations Dictionary
- Formal vocabulary
- Word etymology
- Usage notes
- Academic English
- British and American English
- Grammar and syntax
- Phrasal verbs
- Oxford University Press

## Getting Started & User Guides

- [How-to Guide](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/help.html): User guide and FAQ for Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary features
- [Diagnostic Tests](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/practical-english-usage/diagnostic-tests.html): Practical English Usage diagnostic tests for grammar and vocabulary

## Common & Essential Vocabulary

- [Achievement](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/achievement): Dictionary entry for 'achievement' with pronunciation and usage examples
- [Accident](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accident): Common noun 'accident' with usage notes and examples
- [Accountability](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accountability): Formal vocabulary: 'accountability' noun with OPAL standard notation
- [Absorption](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absorption): Noun 'absorption' with scientific and general usage examples
- [The Accused](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/the-accused): Legal terminology: 'the accused' with criminal law context
- [Accident-prone](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accident-prone): Adjective 'accident-prone' with usage examples and pronunciation

## Specialized & Technical Vocabulary

- [Abdomen](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abdomen): Medical/anatomy term 'abdomen' with definitions and usage notes
- [Absolute Zero](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absolute-zero): Physics term 'absolute zero' temperature definition and usage
- [Acid Salt](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/acid-salt): Chemistry term 'acid salt' with scientific definition
- [Absolute Music](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absolute-music): Music terminology: 'absolute music' instrumental definition
- [Abstractionist (adjective)](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abstractionist_2): Art terminology: 'abstractionist' adjective definition and usage
- [Absurdist](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absurdist_1): Literary term 'absurdist' noun definition and examples

## Phrasal Verbs & Formal Expressions

- [Abound With](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abound-with): Phrasal verb 'abound with' formal vocabulary definition
- [Abnegation](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abnegation): Formal vocabulary: 'abnegation' with Latin etymology
- [Absentia](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absentia): Latin legal phrase 'absentia' (in absentia) definition
